note: Both sets incorrectly bind the 8'-0" dimension to the 'Decking Footing Plan' (C1) instead of the 'Footing Elevation' (C3). Set A is slightly better as it correctly identifies the 'Threaded Rod' and separates components, whereas Set B conflates the nut and sleeve into 'nut sleeve' and invents a condition ('horizontal offset 1'). Set A captures the 3 3/4" top width of the landscape footing which Set B misses, though Set B captures the 4x4 post size which Set A misses. Set A has significant redundancy (5 claims for one bolt), but Set B has more vague 'Component' claims and invented conditions.
